meta.title: Grid
meta.description: Database workbench: connections with groups, colours and TLS modes, a schema browser, an editable data grid, a SQL console with completion, and saved queries — plus read-only database context for the agent.

noWorkspaces: No workspace is registered in this profile yet.
name: Name
estimatedTotal: The engine estimated this row count; Refresh asks for an exact count.
selectConnection: Select a connection on the left to begin.
selectDatabase: Select a database to list its objects.
emptyTables: No tables or views in this database.
insertRowFailed: The row could not be inserted with its defaults.
confirmDeleteConnection: Delete this connection? Its saved password is removed too.
noPrimaryKey: This table has no primary key, so rows cannot be located safely. Editing is disabled.
importNoColumns: Open the table first so its column names are known.
importUnknownColumns: The file has columns this table does not: {cols}
cancelUnsupported: This engine cannot cancel a running statement.
resultTruncated: The result was capped: only the first 2 000 rows are shown.
noQueries: No saved queries yet. Save one from the SQL console, or ask the agent to.
projectBound: This conversation can read {name} ({database}) without asking.
projectUnbound: Not bound to this workspace. The agent has to ask which connection to use.
agentHint: The agent can list, inspect and query these connections with grid_* tools, and save queries for you.
noAccounts: No accounts are visible to this connection.
driverMissing: The {engine} driver is not installed. Run `pnpm add {pkg}` in the plugin directory.
passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved password
secretKeep: Saved credential exists. Leave blank to keep it; use Clear credential to remove it.
secretClearPending: This credential will be cleared on save. Typing a replacement cancels the clear.
sshSingleHopHint: Single jump host only. All SSH server fields and a pinned fingerprint are required.
sshFingerprintHint: Obtain the SHA256:… host fingerprint from your administrator through a trusted channel. It is never discovered or trusted automatically.
sshPrivateKeyHint: Paste the complete private key. Saved private keys are never read back; no host file path is read.
sshDatabaseHostHint: Database host is resolved from the SSH jump host. 127.0.0.1 means the jump host itself.
sshSecurityHint: SSH does not replace database TLS. Keep database TLS enabled when required and use the database server name for certificate verification.
sshDisableHint: Saving with SSH off removes the saved tunnel settings and SSH credentials.
sshFieldsRequired: SSH host, user, authentication method and a pinned SHA256 host fingerprint are required.
sshPortInvalid: SSH port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
sshFingerprintInvalid: Enter a pinned SHA256 host fingerprint (SHA256: followed by 43 base64 characters, optionally ending in =).
tlsServerNameHint: Leave blank to use the database host. This is the database certificate name, not the SSH host or a local forwarding address.
sqlserverVerifyCaUnsupported: SQL Server cannot verify the certificate chain without host-name verification. Choose full verification or another supported TLS mode.
sslVerifyFull: TLS, verify certificate and host name
bannerTools: The agent can inspect and query these connections.
